integrity: Proof establishes the universal minimum by all graph shapes through three vertices; the four-vertex witness uses exact determinant and resultant identities, rational root isolations, and spectral inequalities. Numerical eigenvectors are illustrative and not exhaustive. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem applies to a deterministic additive, symmetric, uniform-rate graph mutation generator. It does not generalize without proof to Eigen multiplicative mutation, finite populations, time-dependent fitness, or networks with five or more genotypes.
title: Four genotypes are the sharp threshold for reentrant mutation–selection abundance rankings
